_about: In-game voice descriptions for the 100 most likely items (Sal, 2026-10-31): short, second-person where natural, checked against what the game does today (recipes, drops, blueprints). Same limits as items.json (110 characters, one full stop). `applied` ids were also written back to items.json/gathered.json description; the others are identical or close to the existing line. Feeds the encyclopedia (data/items/encyclopedia.json) and the tooltip.

descriptions.stone: A fist-sized stone. Pick it up from the ground, or break it off a boulder.
descriptions.stick: A fallen branch. Burns, and makes handles, frames and fences.
descriptions.plant_fibre: Stringy strands from nettles and grass. Twist 3 into twine, or use one to light a fire.
descriptions.twine: Twisted fibre cord. Binds tools, frames and kits.
descriptions.leaves: A handful of green leaves from a felled tree. Roofs a shelter.
descriptions.log: A heavy length of trunk. Split it for firewood, or wedge it into planks.
descriptions.thatch: Bundled dry grass and reed. Roofs, walls and beds are made of it.
descriptions.hide: A raw animal skin. Scrape and tan it for leather, or sew it into clothes.
descriptions.bone: A cleaned bone. Sharpen it into an arrow point, or boil it with hide for glue.
descriptions.sinew: Tough strands from an animal's legs. Makes strong thread and bowstrings.
descriptions.feather: A bird's feather. Fletch arrows with it, or stuff a bed.
descriptions.animal_fat: Fat from a kill. Render it for tallow, or cook with it.
descriptions.raw_meat: Fresh meat. Cook it before you eat it, and do not keep it long.
descriptions.roast_meat: Meat roasted over a fire. Filling, and it keeps a couple of days.
descriptions.stone_axe: A stone bound to a handle. Fells trees, breaks rock and works wood.
descriptions.stone_knife: A flaked stone on a handle. Dresses a kill and cuts bark.
descriptions.wooden_spear: A sharpened stick. Jab with it or throw it.
descriptions.spear: A stone point on a long shaft. Jab with it or throw it; it kills a rabbit in one blow.
descriptions.wooden_spade: A sharpened wooden blade. Digs roots and bulbs.
descriptions.stone_spade: A spade with a stone blade. Digs deeper and lasts longer than wood.
descriptions.stone_hammer: A hafted stone hammer. Hold it to place big builds from blueprints.
descriptions.stone_pickaxe: A heavy stone head on a haft. Breaks boulders and ore, slowly.
descriptions.wooden_hoe: A flat blade on a long handle. Paths the ground and tills beds.
descriptions.stone_hoe: A hoe with a stone blade. Lasts longer than wood.
descriptions.wooden_bow: A bow of bent wood and twine. Needs arrows.
descriptions.wooden_arrow: A hardened stick with feather fletching. Needs a bow.
descriptions.stone_arrow: An arrow with a flaked stone point. Hits harder than wood.
descriptions.fibre_arrow: A hardened stick with fibre fletching. Weak and short, but needs no feather.
descriptions.bone_arrow: An arrow with a sharpened bone point.
descriptions.fishing_rod: A stick, line and hook. Cast at water, then click again when something bites.
descriptions.shore_net: A weighted twine net. Hold the button at the water's edge for about 20 seconds.
descriptions.torch: A stick wrapped in fibre. Lights your way after dark.
descriptions.campfire_kit: Stones and sticks for a fire. Set it down, then light it with fibre.
descriptions.lean_to_kit: Sticks, leaves and twine for a small shelter. Gives cover from rain.
descriptions.rough_bed_kit: Thatch bound with twine. Set it under a roof and lie down to sleep.
descriptions.workbench_kit: Lashed sticks and a flat top. A work table for better tools.
descriptions.chest_kit: Woven sticks and twine. A chest to store things in.
descriptions.tool_rack_kit: Pegs and a crossbar. Set it beside a bench to raise its level.
descriptions.chopping_block: A log set on end. Split wooden blocks into firewood on it.
descriptions.hide_cloak: A wrapped animal hide. Warm over the shoulders.
descriptions.hide_boots: Hide stitched around the foot. Warm and tough.
descriptions.hide_hood: A close hood of hide with the hair turned in.
descriptions.hide_tunic: A sewn hide shirt with sleeves. Warmer than a cloak.
descriptions.hide_trousers: Hide sewn into trousers. Better than leggings.
descriptions.hide_gloves: Stitched hide gloves with fingers. For work and cold.
descriptions.fur_cloak: A heavy cloak of fur pelts. The warmest body cover.
descriptions.grass_cloak: Woven grass over the shoulders. Keeps a little wind off.
descriptions.fibre_sandals: Twisted fibre soles tied to the foot.
descriptions.backpack: A hide pack with straps. Worn on the back, it lets you carry more.
descriptions.waterskin: A sewn skin bag for carrying a drink.
descriptions.bandage: Leaves and fibre bound round a wound.
descriptions.herb_salve: Comfrey worked into fat. Soothes burns and sore skin.
descriptions.splint: Two straight sticks bound to a limb to hold a broken bone still.
descriptions.poultice: Crushed herb leaves bound on a wound.
descriptions.trout: A cold-water fish from streams. Cook it before you eat it.
descriptions.perch: A common fish of ponds and lakes. Cook it before you eat it.
descriptions.carp: A heavy fish of still ponds. Cook it before you eat it.
descriptions.pike: A long hunting fish of lakes. Cook it before you eat it.
descriptions.roast_fish: Fish cooked over a fire. Filling, and keeps a day or two.
descriptions.smoked_fish: Fish smoked over juniper. Lasts for weeks.
descriptions.nut_paste: Ground hazelnuts and sweet nectar. Keeps well.
descriptions.roast_roots: Roots baked in the embers. Plain and filling.
descriptions.hunters_stew: A thick meat and root stew. Warms you through.
descriptions.trail_bread: Dense seed and nut loaves. Barely spoils.
descriptions.flatbread: A flat cake baked on hot clay. Plain and filling.
descriptions.kindling: Thin dry twigs. The start of any fire.
descriptions.firewood: Split wood. Burns long and steady.
descriptions.tinder: Fine dry stuff that takes a spark. Two thatch make two.
descriptions.wooden_block: A short round of log. Split it on a chopping block.
descriptions.stone_wedge: A flaked stone wedge. Driven into a log at a workbench, it splits two rough planks.
descriptions.lumber: Boards from a log. Make them at a saw mill, or wedge them at a workbench.
descriptions.clay: A heavy, sticky shovelful of clay. Fire it for bricks and pots.
descriptions.brick: A fired clay brick. Builds the clay hearth and the oven.
descriptions.soil: A shovelful of dark earth, dug from the ground.
descriptions.gravel: A shovelful of small stones and grit.
descriptions.flint: A hard grey stone that sparks when struck. Common near rivers.
descriptions.copper_ore: A heavy lump streaked green and red. Smelts to copper in a forge.
descriptions.tin_ore: A dark, very heavy lump. Smelts to tin in a forge.
descriptions.iron_ore: A rusty brown lump. Smelts to iron with coal in a forge.
descriptions.coal: A black lump that burns hot. Smelts iron and makes steel.
descriptions.copper_ingot: Smelted copper. Soft, but good for early tools.
descriptions.iron_ingot: A bar of smelted iron. Hard, for tools and nails.
descriptions.nails: Small iron nails. Fix boards in builds.
descriptions.quern: Two flat stones for grinding grain by hand. Slow but steady.
descriptions.flour: Ground grain. The start of bread.
descriptions.compost: Rotted plant matter. Feeds a tilled bed.
descriptions.wheat_seeds: Seeds for sowing wheat. Plant them in a tilled bed in spring.
descriptions.seed_bundle: A bundle of seeds. Eat them, or plant them.
descriptions.raspberries: Soft red berries that crumble when picked. Ripe in summer.
descriptions.blueberries: Small blue berries from low bushes. Ripe in summer.
descriptions.hazelnuts: Round hard-shelled nuts. Crack and eat; they keep well.
descriptions.acorns: Oak nuts, bitter raw. Soaked and mashed they make a poor but filling food.
descriptions.wild_carrot_roots: Thin pale roots, tough but sweet. Cook them or chew them raw.
descriptions.plantain_leaves: Broad ribbed leaves. Chew and bind on stings and cuts.
descriptions.comfrey_leaves: Rough hairy leaves. Bruise and bind on sprains.
descriptions.staunchmoss: Spongy moss that stops bleeding when packed on a wound.
descriptions.willow_bark: Bitter grey bark. Steeped, it eases pain and fever.
descriptions.chamomile_flowers: Small white daisies. Make a calming tea.
descriptions.candle: A wick dipped in fat. A small steady light for indoors.
descriptions.tallow: Animal fat rendered clean in a pot. Burns well and keeps.
